RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

That number is a low-confidence subjective estimate, not a statistically grounded probability. An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination.

Your qualifications justify seeking feedback, but longer experience doesn’t automatically establish greater suitability for group leadership. Client relationships, commercial performance, management skills and interview performance may have mattered; the announcement isn’t her full résumé.

Follow up now, requesting the selection criteria, how your application was assessed and specific feedback. Two weeks’ silence warrants a reminder, not an inference of bias.

Raise discrimination concerns if concrete evidence emerges—such as sex-based comments, inconsistent criteria or unequal treatment—not simply because of the panel’s composition.
